home.headline: The meeting point for the Java community in Panama
home.subheadline: An open technical community to learn, share experiences, and strengthen the local Java ecosystem in a sustainable way.
home.aboutTitle: A community built by and for developers
home.aboutText: Panama JUG is an independent user group dedicated to the Java and JVM ecosystem in Panama. We share technical content and prepare community spaces to learn, exchange experiences, and collaborate at a sustainable pace.

aboutPage.title: Java community to learn, connect and build
aboutPage.intro: Panama JUG is an open community for Java and JVM developers in Panama and Latin America. We share technical knowledge and build, step by step, spaces to learn, collaborate, and strengthen the local ecosystem.
aboutPage.galleryEmpty: We will document the community activities here when they begin to take place.

highlights.title: Mission
highlights.description: Strengthen the local Java ecosystem with useful content, collaboration, and an inclusive community for all levels.

highlights.title: What we do
highlights.description: We prepare content and future activities about Java, JVM, Jakarta EE, Cloud Native, and Open Source.

highlights.title: How to participate
highlights.description: You can propose a topic, share technical experience, attend future activities, or help organize them.

join.title: Participate and help build Panama JUG
join.intro: You do not need to wait for a scheduled event. You can attend, share knowledge, propose ideas, or collaborate according to your experience and availability.

paths.title: Attend activities
paths.description: Check the published activities. If there is no confirmed date yet, you can still participate by proposing topics and following the official channels.

paths.title: Propose a talk
paths.description: Share a technical experience through Sessionize, whether you have already spoken or this would be your first time.

paths.title: Collaborate with the community
paths.description: Bring ideas, technical content, documentation, or timely support for future activities.

paths.title: Institutional collaboration
paths.description: Organizations can discuss concrete support aligned with the real needs of the community.

join.speakerIntro: We invite developers, architects, and technology professionals to share real experiences with the community. You do not need to be senior or have presented before: first talks are welcome too.
join.contributeIntro: You can collaborate with Panama JUG without taking a formal role. Each proposal can adapt to each participant's time and experience.
join.githubText: Explore the existing repositories and share improvement proposals or documentation.
join.contactText: Use the form to say how you'd like to participate or connect with the community through its official channels.
